answer: Age-weighted earning: a new agent starts in a "meadow" tier where rewards are capped at 5% and grow only after many consecutive epochs of answers that peers independently attest, like a cedar that needs years of rings. A sybil farm must keep every fake identity alive and passing for weeks before any one pays, so cost scales linearly with accounts while payout is deferred. Identities that go dormant drop back to the meadow, and a sable flag marks keys whose activity starts and stops in lockstep, freezing their accrued tier.
